notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
gobuster vhost fuzzes the HTTP Host header against a target IP to discover virtual hosts with no DNS entries. A virtual host can exist without a public DNS record — DNS enumeration alone won't find it. Only discoverable by directly testing Host header values.

=== HOW IT WORKS ===
Iterates wordlist → constructs Host: {word}.{domain} → sends HTTP request to target IP → records responses differing from baseline (by status code or response size).

=== --append-domain ===
Required in newer gobuster versions to form full hostnames (word.domain.com) rather than sending bare wordlist words. Without it: malformed Host headers → unreliable results.

=== DETECTION ===
High request volume against single IP — detectable by IDS/WAF. -t flag increases threads for speed but increases detection risk. Active technique requiring authorization.

=== vs SUBDOMAIN BRUTEFORCE ===
VHost fuzzing: no DNS queries, tests Host header directly against IP. Subdomain bruteforce: queries DNS for each candidate. VHosts with no DNS records are only found by VHost fuzzing.
